draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.94, the 168th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 20th of 37 at CB. He went 115th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (168th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing concerns: 10-yard split (6th percentile). College production: 5 passes defended in 2021, 18th of 31 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Cleveland Browns (reserve). 43 career games and 18 starts over 3 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2024 against a career-best 4 in 2022. Weak spots: season snap share 6.9% (12th percentile), approximate value 1 (17th percentile). Played 10 of 17 games in 2024. Versus the typical Year-3 cornerback who played: 6.9% season snap share against a median of 40.4%, below the norm.
